# pbs_datastores (Data Source)

Lists the datastores of a Proxmox Backup Server, of every kind, with their configuration. The list has the datastores the provider has `Datastore.Audit` on.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pbs_datastores" "all" {}

output "datastores" {
  value = { for d in data.pbs_datastores.all.datastores : d.name => d.path }
}

# Datastores without a garbage collection schedule, whose pruned backups keep
# their space until a collection is started by hand.
output "datastores_without_gc" {
  value = [for d in data.pbs_datastores.all.datastores : d.name if d.gc_schedule == null]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `datastores` (Attributes List) The datastores, sorted by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores))

<a id="nestedatt--datastores"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores`

Read-Only:

- `backend` (Attributes) For a datastore on S3, where its backups are; null for one in a directory or on a removable disk. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores--backend))
- `backend_type` (String) Where the datastore keeps its chunks: `filesystem` or `s3`.
- `backing_device` (String) For a removable datastore, the UUID of the file system on its disk; null otherwise.
- `comment` (String) Comment; null when there is none.
- `counter_reset_schedule` (String) For a datastore on S3, when PBS resets its request and traffic counters, as a calendar event; null for never.
- `gc_on_unmount` (Boolean) Whether PBS runs garbage collection on a removable datastore before it unmounts it.
- `gc_schedule` (String) When garbage collection runs, as a calendar event; null when it runs only when started.
- `maintenance_mode` (Attributes) The datastore's maintenance mode; null when there is none. Besides `read-only` and `offline`, which are set by hand, PBS sets `unmount`, `delete` and `s3-refresh` itself while it unmounts, deletes or refreshes the datastore. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores--maintenance_mode))
- `mount_status` (String) Whether a removable datastore is mounted: `mounted` or `notmounted`; `nonremovable` for any other datastore.
- `name` (String) Datastore name.
- `notification_mode` (String) `notification-system` or `legacy-sendmail`.
- `notification_thresholds` (Attributes) For a datastore on S3, how many requests and bytes to its bucket make PBS send a notification; null when none do. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores--notification_thresholds))
- `notify` (Attributes) With `legacy-sendmail`, which mails PBS sends; null when it sends its defaults. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores--notify))
- `notify_user` (String) With `legacy-sendmail`, the user who gets the mails; null for `root@pam`.
- `path` (String) Absolute path of the datastore's directory, or for a removable datastore the directory's path on its device; for a datastore on S3 object storage, the local cache.
- `tuning` (Attributes) Tuning options; null when all are at PBS's defaults, and each one left out is. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--datastores--tuning))
- `verify_new` (Boolean) Whether PBS verifies every new backup.

<a id="nestedatt--datastores--backend"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores.backend`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) Bucket that holds the backups, under the datastore's name.
- `client` (String) ID of the S3 endpoint.
- `max_cache_size` (String) Most space the local cache of chunks may take, as PBS stores it; null for the free space of `path`.
- `type` (String) `s3`.


<a id="nestedatt--datastores--maintenance_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores.maintenance_mode`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String) Why, as PBS shows it to clients; null when there is no message.
- `type` (String) `read-only`, `offline`, `unmount`, `delete` or `s3-refresh`.


<a id="nestedatt--datastores--notification_thresholds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores.notification_thresholds`

Read-Only:

- `s3_delete` (Number) Number of `DELETE` requests.
- `s3_download` (String) Bytes downloaded, as PBS stores them.
- `s3_get` (Number) Number of `GET` requests.
- `s3_head` (Number) Number of `HEAD` requests.
- `s3_post` (Number) Number of `POST` requests.
- `s3_put` (Number) Number of `PUT` requests.
- `s3_upload` (String) Bytes uploaded, as PBS stores them.


<a id="nestedatt--datastores--notify"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores.notify`

Read-Only:

- `gc` (String) When PBS mails about garbage collection: `always`, `error` or `never`.
- `prune` (String) When PBS mails about prune jobs: `always`, `error` or `never`.
- `sync` (String) When PBS mails about sync jobs: `always`, `error` or `never`.
- `verify` (String) When PBS mails about verify jobs: `always`, `error` or `never`.


<a id="nestedatt--datastores--tuning"></a>
### Nested Schema for `datastores.tuning`

Read-Only:

- `chunk_order` (String) `inode` or `none`.
- `default_verification_readers` (Number) Threads that read chunks in a verification that does not set its own.
- `default_verification_workers` (Number) Threads that verify chunks in a verification that does not set its own.
- `gc_atime_cutoff` (Number) Minutes after which garbage collection treats a chunk it did not mark as unused.
- `gc_atime_safety_check` (Boolean) Whether PBS checks that the file system updates access times.
- `gc_cache_capacity` (Number) How many chunk digests garbage collection caches.
- `sync_level` (String) `filesystem`, `file` or `none`.
